editorial: Step into a claustrophobic world where domestic boredom curdles into a dangerous game of surveillance. You will find a provocative exploration of power dynamics that pushes the boundaries of the early 90s erotic thriller. Gregory Dark delivers a visually sleazy yet polished atmosphere that makes the voyeurism feel uncomfortably intimate. If you crave a high-tension descent into obsession and betrayal, this is your ticket. Prepare for a ride that proves some secrets are better left unseen.
targetAudience: Ideal for fans of neon-soaked 90s noir and psychological power plays.
